headword: {電動自転車|でんどうじてんしゃ}

definitions.explanation: A bicycle equipped with an electric motor that assists the rider's pedaling. Extremely popular in Japan, especially among parents with young children, commuters, and the elderly for navigating hilly terrain.

examples.japanese: {電動自転車|でんどうじてんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{電動自転車|でんどうじてんしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Since there are many hills, an electric bicycle is convenient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}せて→乗せる：01972_noseru⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{電動自転車|でんどうじてんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検討|けんとう}している→検討する：17455_kentousuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm considering buying an electric bicycle to commute with my child on board.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, this usually refers to ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧⟦アシスト→アシスト：29696_ashisuto⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧ (electric-assist bicycle), where the motor only assists pedaling rather than providing full propulsion. Fully electric models that move without pedaling are classified differently and may require registration.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電動自転車|でんどうじてんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧ (e-bike battery)
- {電動自転車|でんどうじてんしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to charge an e-bike)
- ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧{乗|の}せ{電動自転車|でんどうじてんしゃ} (child-carrying e-bike)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧: bicycle — the general term for any bicycle
- ⟦{電動|でんどう}→電動：06412_dendou⟧⟦アシスト→アシスト：29696_ashisuto⟧⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧: electric-assist bicycle — the formal/full name
